sources.entry: Atoll - Turns the notch into a Dynamic Island-style hub for media controls, live activities, and quick utilities. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Ebullioscopic/Atoll)

summary.one_liner: Atoll is an open-source macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style hub for media controls, system stats, live activities, and quick productivity tools.
summary.what_it_does: Atoll expands the notch area into a control surface that appears on hover or click. It offers media controls for Apple Music, Spotify, Cider, and other players with inline previews, and shows live activities for playback, Focus, screen recording, privacy indicators, downloads (beta), and battery/charging. It can also show system metrics for CPU, GPU, memory, network, and disk usage. Productivity tools include timers, clipboard history, a color picker, and calendar previews. A Shelf feature accepts files, including via `open -a Atoll /path/to/file` from Terminal. The README also describes lock screen widgets (media, timers, charging, Bluetooth devices, weather) and gesture controls such as two-finger swipes and horizontal trackpad swipes for track skipping or seeking.
use_cases: show media playback controls in the MacBook notch
monitor CPU, memory, and network usage at a glance
keep clipboard history and quick timers handy
add lock screen widgets for weather and timers
control music with trackpad swipes from the notch
how_to_run: Download the latest DMG from the releases link in the README.
Open the DMG and drag Atoll into Applications.
Launch Atoll and grant the requested permissions (Accessibility, Camera, Calendar, Screen Recording, Music as needed).
To build from source, use Xcode 15+ (the README does not give further build commands).
notable: Turns the MacBook notch into an expandable Dynamic Island-style command surface
Lightweight system stats (CPU, GPU, memory, network, disk), with CPU temperature and frequency sampling adapted from the Stats project
Gesture control turns the music pane into a trackpad for previous/next or ±10 second seeks
Lock screen widgets for media, timers, charging, Bluetooth devices, and weather via Open Meteo
Built on Boring.Notch and inspired by Alcove and DynamicNotch
caveats: Requires a MacBook with a notch and macOS 14.0 or later (optimised for macOS 15+)
Several permissions are needed (Accessibility, Camera, Calendar, Screen Recording, Music), and some features require relaunching after granting them
Downloads live activity is marked as beta
